full_prompt_en: The image is a square classical oil painting of four robed men examining a broad sheet of paper beside a carved stone column. A deep brown interior fills the upper left and center background, with very little visible furniture or decoration. On the right, a pale architectural column rises beyond the figures; its capital and carved vertical bands catch the light and establish the room's scale. In the foreground at left, a balding man turns his back toward the viewer, his heavy ochre robe forming a broad warm shape that reaches the bottom edge. Behind him, a dark-haired and bearded man leans forward over his shoulder, looking down toward the sheet. At the center, an older man with gray hair and a full white beard holds the paper low across his body. His dusty rose tunic shows beneath a vivid blue-green drape that folds over his shoulder and forearm, and his gaze turns toward the man at the far right. The rightmost man, seen in profile, has a receding hairline, a short gray beard, and a coral-red robe. His arms gather the cloth as he faces the central figure. A hand between the left group and the central man is raised with one finger extended, directing attention to the discussion around the paper. The paper itself is tan and darkened in shadow, with no legible writing visible. Warm light enters from the left front, illuminating foreheads, noses, beards, the central blue-green folds, and the pale column, while the space behind them remains subdued. The paint models faces with smooth gradual transitions and gives the thick cloth more decisive folds and deeper color. The figures are arranged close to the picture plane, their shoulders overlapping in a shallow semicircle around the sheet. The overall composition uses saturated teal, ochre, rose, and coral against a dark room to focus a quiet, concentrated exchange.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形古典油画，四名身披长袍的男子在雕刻石柱旁查看一张宽大的纸。深棕色室内空间填满左上方和中央背景，几乎看不见家具或其他装饰。右侧一根浅色建筑立柱从人物后方升起，柱头和雕刻的竖带承接受光，也显出房间尺度。左前景一位头顶稀疏的男子背对观者，厚重的赭色长袍形成延伸到底边的宽大暖色形状。他后面一位深发蓄须的男子从肩头上方俯身，低头看向纸张。中央一位灰发、留浓白须的年长男子把纸低低地举在身前。他的灰玫瑰色内衣露在鲜明的蓝绿色披布下，披布沿肩和前臂形成褶皱；他的视线转向最右侧的男子。最右边的人以侧脸出现，发际后移、蓄短灰须，穿珊瑚红长袍。他收拢衣布，朝向中央人物。左侧人群与中央男子之间有一只手抬起，伸出一根手指，将注意力引向围绕纸张的交流。纸本身是处在阴影里的褐色，看不见可读的文字。暖光从左前方进入，照亮额头、鼻子、胡须、中央蓝绿色褶皱与浅色柱子，后方空间则较暗。颜料以平顺渐变塑造面孔，以更明确的折线和深色表现厚布。人物靠近画面前缘，肩膀相互遮挡，围绕纸张形成浅浅的半圆。整体构图在暗室中使用饱和的青色、赭色、玫瑰色与珊瑚红，将焦点集中在安静而专注的交流上。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting models rounded forms with gradual tonal transitions and controlled, closely observed light. Deep warm neutrals occupy the background so concentrated teal, ochre, rose, and coral areas can carry the foreground structure. Soft edges turn through shaded volume, while illuminated folds and selected profile lines become more precise. Cloth gathers into broad curved planes with darker creases, contrasting with smoother, lighter surfaces nearby. A single warm frontal side light picks out the highest planes and leaves the surrounding space in restrained brown shadow. Overlapping large forms create a shallow, intimate arrangement around a quiet central focal area. The overall treatment is composed and weighty, with rich color set against a subdued architectural atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画以渐进的明度转换和受控制、细致观察的光线塑造圆润体积。深暖中性色占据背景，使集中的青、赭、玫瑰与珊瑚色域承担前景结构。柔软边缘随背光体积转折，受光褶皱与选定的侧面线条则更精确。布面聚成宽阔弧面与较深的折痕，同邻近更平滑明亮的表面形成对比。单一暖色前侧光挑出最高的平面，让周围空间停留在克制的棕色阴影里。大形体相互遮挡，在安静的中央焦点周围形成浅而亲密的排列。整体处理沉着且厚重，浓郁色彩立于低调的建筑性氛围前。
